sources.title: Hy-MT2 30B A3B: Specifications and GPU VRAM Requirements
sources.snippet: Hy-MT2 30B A3B is Tencent's flagship mixture-of-experts translation model with 3B active parameters out of 30B total. It delivers high-accuracy translation across 33 language pairs with advanced support for context-aware and glossary-based tasks.

sources.title: Hy-MT2-30B-A3B - model.xinference.io
sources.snippet: Hy-MT2 is a family of "fast-thinking" multilingual translation models designed for complex real-world scenarios. It includes three model sizes: 1.8B, 7B, and 30B-A3B (MoE), all of which support translation among 33 languages and effectively follow translation instructions in multiple languages.
